original.target_description: Experiment 1: recognition discriminability (da), self-paced study duration versus fixed-rate yoked controls; paired item analysis across 160 words.

n.sample_role: Words/items as paired analytic observations, with one discriminability estimate per condition for each word; 148 participants contribute responses, not 148 item-level observations.
n.exclusions: Four primacy and four recency buffer words excluded from analysis. The explicitly specified 160-word test list comprises the selected nonbuffer words; each participant studied a randomized subset of 80 and was tested on all 160.

n.quote: All 160 words ... comprised the test list. ... an item analysis, in which discrimination was calculated for ... each word once from the combined responses of the entire ... group of self-paced subjects and once from the combined re- ... sponses of the entire group of control subjects.

replication.target_description: Pooled mini-meta-analysis across Experiments 1–4; recognition discriminability, self-paced stimulus ONSET versus fixed-pace; item analysis of words/faces.

n.exclusions: Pooled analytic n is not explicitly printed beside this test. Do not equate the denominator degrees of freedom to a printed n. Experiment-specific buffer and participant exclusions are described separately.

notes:
The original locators use article-relative pages, excluding the author-copy cover sheet. The replication p. 10 locator identifies the pooled onset-control analysis, not the direct offset-control replication in Experiment 1 on journal p. 710. Thus the located replication contrast differs conceptually from the original duration/offset contrast; target_match refers to the supplied neutral description and page locator. No metric conversion or n reconstruction was performed. Original p is the authors’ section-wide printed significance bound, not an exact p. The item-level narrative is classified mixed because the authors report better item memory while questioning whether this establishes a benefit.
Completion source review (n_o): The explicit 160-word test list and per-word paired analysis establish the analytic observation count; participant contributors are a separate role.
Completion source review (es_value_o): The item-level locator identifies the overall paired item analysis and its printed t statistic, not the subsequent strategy-subgroup tests.
Completion source review (pval_value_o): Opening Results convention states significance at alpha < .05; the target item comparison is explicitly significant. Preserve p < .05, without computing exact p.
Completion source review (es_value_r): Item-level description identifies the pooled item analysis. Extract printed d without conversion; no further standardisation convention asserted.
Completion source review (pval_value_r): Printed p < .001 belongs to the same item-level test as d=0.17 and t(639)=5.70; retain strict upper bound.
Completion source review (reported_success): Authors explicitly say it is difficult to discern whether the small item effect alone demonstrates a benefit and that the item/subject discrepancy is unclear. Vocabulary uninformative records this narrative assessment rather than inferring success from p.
